en: "The Map"{SAUT}Learn {f 0 1 2}how to fill in the map{f 0 1 0}.
The {f 0 1 2}map{f 0 1 0} can be viewed on the lower{SAUT}screen. Filling in the map is key to your{SAUT}escape from this world.
Expand or shrink the map by pressing the{SAUT}{f 0 1 2}Y Button{f 0 1 0} or by double-tapping the map.
Tap the {f 0 1 2}compass{f 0 1 0} in the upper left, and{SAUT}the map will rotate to match the direction{SAUT}you are facing.
Tap the {f 0 1 2}pencil tool{f 0 1 0}, and you'll be able to{SAUT}draw walls on the map.
Tap the {f 0 1 2}brush tool{f 0 1 0} to color in floor spaces.
Change the brush tool's color with the{SAUT}{f 0 1 2}color palette{f 0 1 0}.
{f 0 1 2}(1) The eraser tool{f 0 1 0} removes walls.{SAUT}{f 0 1 2}(2) The dustcloth tool{f 0 1 0} erases floors.

Floor spaces get filled in automatically{SAUT}just by walking on them, but you'll have{SAUT}to {f 0 1 2}mark down walls yourself{f 0 1 0}. Refer to{SAUT}{f 0 1 2}HELP{f 0 1 0} at the bottom right of the map for{SAUT}more information.
